mentions.name: Bespoke Books
mentions.description: This service generates custom coloring books for kids using the nano banana AI image model. It started as a coloring book for the author's son and is available as a website; a phone app and prompt improvements are planned next.
mentions.source_excerpt: On the side, custom coloring books for kids using nano banana, started with a project for my son, and its a little janky for some photos but have had some interest already: https://bespokebooks.io.
